title: BiteForceMC
description: BiteForceMC is a cobblemon server, focusing on a custom experience for all players.
body:
⚔️Welcome to BiteForceMC's Cobblemon! ⚔️

Ready to dive into the ultimate Cobblemon experience? The BiteForceMC custom modpack pushes Cobblemon far beyond vanilla with exclusive features, enhanced mechanics, and a carefully curated lineup of must-have mods that make your Pokémon journey feel alive. We’re always rolling out updates, optimizations, and fixes to keep the experience smooth, balanced, and addictive.

🌍 Explore. Battle. Progress. Journey through a massive Cobblemon world covering Generations 1-9. Discover endless biomes, face off against trainers from around the world, and challenge fully NPC-run gyms designed to test your skills. Earn your badges, prove your strength, and carve your own legacy.

⚔️ Built for Competitive & Peaceful Players Alike At BiteForceMC, everyone belongs. Whether you’re a hardcore competitive battler chasing perfect teams or a peaceful PvE player who just wants to explore, build, and enjoy the world at your own pace, we’ve got you covered.

🚀 Not Just a Modpack. A Force. BiteForceMC offers access to Quality builds specifically for smooth, immersive multiplayer gameplay. Team up with friends or go solo in a world crafted for stability, performance, and nonstop fun.

🔗Our Links: 🌐Website: https://biteforcemc.com 🌀Discord: https://discord.biteforcemc.com
